note: Subject texts of the Martian faction (bead pulp_wars-t6s.6, docs/art/factions/MARTIAN.md). The faction has fixed colours: chrome, gunmetal, lavender-grey skin and one hot magenta accent; no owner colour.

subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:FIGHTER: Subject: Grunt, a chunky cute little alien trooper with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, no nose and a tiny mouth, inside a clear round glass bubble helmet with one white highlight and a short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip; a plain polished silver-white space suit shaded soft blue-grey, with a dark gunmetal collar ring, belt, gloves and boots and one small hot magenta chest light; an oversized chunky silver ray pistol with small fins and a glowing hot magenta muzzle held up in the right hand; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:MARKSMAN: Subject: Ray Gunner, a chunky cute little alien gunner with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, no nose and a tiny mouth, inside a clear round glass bubble helmet with one white highlight and a short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip; a plain polished silver-white space suit shaded soft blue-grey, with a dark gunmetal collar ring, belt, gloves and boots and one small hot magenta chest light and a dark gunmetal power tank on the back; a huge long silver ray rifle with big fins and three ring coils held in both hands across the body, with a big round glowing hot magenta emitter ball at its muzzle; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a shooter with a very big gun.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:GUARD: Subject: Shield Projector, a chunky cute sturdy little alien trooper with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a wide heavy body: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, no nose and a tiny mouth, inside a clear round glass bubble helmet with one white highlight and a short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip; a heavy polished silver-white armoured space suit with big rounded shoulder plates, shaded soft blue-grey, with dark gunmetal collar, belt, gloves and boots; he holds in both hands in front of his body one big round silver dish emitter like a small radar dish with a glowing hot magenta centre, and one thin curved hot magenta arc of energy shimmers in front of the dish; wide braced stance; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a defender, not a shooter.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:CAPTAIN: Subject: Brain, a chunky cute alien brain in a jar on a walking carrier: one very big wrinkled pale lavender-grey brain with two small glossy black eyes, floating inside a large clear round glass jar dome with one white highlight that takes up the top two thirds of the image, a few small glowing hot magenta sparks around the brain, sitting on a small round polished chrome base with a row of three small hot magenta lights, carried on four short bent dark gunmetal spider legs; simple shapes and very few details; the feet of the legs are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:RAIDER: Subject: Saucer, a small classic 1950s flying saucer, flying: one wide round polished chrome disc seen slightly from above, a row of small round glowing hot magenta running lights around its rim, a clear pale glass dome on top with one white highlight and the tiny bald lavender-grey head of an alien pilot with big black eyes inside, a dark gunmetal underside with one short round beam emitter glowing hot magenta under its centre; no legs and no landing gear; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a small fast scout ship.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:CATAPULT: Subject: Tripod, a tall three-legged walking war machine: a rounded hooded polished chrome head like a smooth cowl with rivets, with one big round glowing hot magenta eye lens in front, standing high on three long thin jointed dark gunmetal legs with round chrome knee joints and small round feet, and one bent mechanical arm under the head that ends in a heat-ray emitter with a glowing hot magenta tip; tall and narrow; simple shapes and very few details; the three feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a walking siege machine, much taller than a soldier.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:KNIGHT: Subject: Mothership, a large grand 1950s flying saucer, flying: a very wide thick polished chrome disc built in two stacked tiers, seen slightly from above, with a ring of many round glowing hot magenta lights around its rim, a big clear pale glass dome on top with one white highlight and a short antenna with a hot magenta tip, three small chrome fins, and a dark gunmetal underside with one big round open beam port glowing hot magenta under its centre; no legs and no landing gear; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a big heavy command ship, much bigger and grander than a scout saucer.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Colossus, a huge heavy armoured three-legged walking war machine: a massive rounded polished chrome head with thick riveted armour plates, a dark gunmetal visor band with two big round glowing hot magenta eye lenses, a short antenna with a hot magenta tip, standing on three thick sturdy armoured chrome legs with big round dark gunmetal joints and wide flat feet, and one big heavy heat-ray cannon arm with ring coils and a glowing hot magenta muzzle; wide and towering; simple shapes and very few details; the three feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a giant war machine, far bigger than any soldier.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:THRALL: Subject: Thrall, a chunky cute mind-controlled soldier with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body, slumped and hunched with drooping shoulders and both arms hanging down: a pale grey blank face with two empty round white eyes and no pupils, a polished chrome control helmet clamped over the top of the head with a short antenna and one glowing hot magenta light on its front, a dark gunmetal collar ring round the neck, a plain drab mid-grey tunic and trousers with no emblem, dark grey boots, a plain dull grey short club hanging low in one hand; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a dazed puppet, not a knight and not an alien.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:FIGHTER: Subject: Grunt portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute little alien trooper: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, no nose and a tiny mouth, inside a clear round glass bubble helmet with one white highlight and a short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip; the shoulders of a polished silver-white space suit with a dark gunmetal collar ring; a chunky silver ray pistol with a glowing hot magenta muzzle raised beside the head.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:MARKSMAN: Subject: Ray Gunner portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute little alien gunner: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, no nose and a tiny mouth, inside a clear round glass bubble helmet with one white highlight and a short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip; the shoulders of a polished silver-white space suit with a dark gunmetal collar ring; a huge finned silver ray rifle with ring coils and a big glowing hot magenta emitter ball resting on the shoulder.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:GUARD: Subject: Shield Projector portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute sturdy little alien trooper: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, no nose and a tiny mouth, inside a clear round glass bubble helmet with one white highlight and a short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip; big rounded polished silver-white shoulder plates with a dark gunmetal collar ring; the top half of a big round silver dish emitter with a glowing hot magenta centre held in front of the chest.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:CAPTAIN: Subject: Brain, a chunky cute alien brain in a jar, shown whole and large: one very big wrinkled pale lavender-grey brain with two small glossy black eyes floating inside a large clear round glass jar dome with one white highlight, a few small glowing hot magenta sparks, on a small round polished chrome base with three small hot magenta lights; no legs; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:RAIDER: Subject: Saucer, a small classic 1950s flying saucer shown whole: one wide round polished chrome disc with a row of small round glowing hot magenta lights around its rim, a clear pale glass dome on top with one white highlight and the tiny lavender-grey head of an alien pilot with big black eyes inside, a dark gunmetal underside; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:CATAPULT: Subject: Tripod, the head of a three-legged walking war machine shown large: a rounded hooded polished chrome head like a smooth cowl with rivets, one big round glowing hot magenta eye lens in front, the tops of three thin dark gunmetal legs below it and a small heat-ray emitter arm with a glowing hot magenta tip; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:KNIGHT: Subject: Mothership, a large grand 1950s flying saucer shown whole: a very wide thick polished chrome disc in two stacked tiers with a ring of many round glowing hot magenta lights around its rim, a big clear pale glass dome on top with one white highlight and a short antenna, a dark gunmetal underside with a big round beam port glowing hot magenta; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Colossus, the head of a huge armoured walking war machine shown large: a massive rounded polished chrome head with thick riveted armour plates, a dark gunmetal visor band with two big round glowing hot magenta eye lenses, a short antenna with a hot magenta tip, and the muzzle of a heavy heat-ray cannon with ring coils beside it; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:THRALL: Subject: Thrall portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute mind-controlled soldier with drooping shoulders: a pale grey blank face with two empty round white eyes and no pupils, a polished chrome control helmet clamped over the top of the head with a short antenna and one glowing hot magenta light on its front, a dark gunmetal collar ring, a plain drab mid-grey tunic.
subjects.CITY:MARTIAN:1/CALM: Subject: a small level-1 alien colony, the first of three sizes of one colony: one landed flying saucer of polished silver-white chrome standing on three short dark gunmetal landing legs, with a pale glass dome on top and a row of small bright hot magenta lights around its rim, two small round silver-white chrome dome huts with one bright hot magenta round window each pressed against it, and one thin tall silver antenna mast with a small ball on top; no wall, no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:MARTIAN:2/CALM: Subject: a medium level-2 alien colony, the second of three sizes of one colony: one big landed flying saucer of polished silver-white chrome on three short dark gunmetal landing legs, with a pale glass dome and a row of bright hot magenta lights around its rim, four round silver-white chrome dome buildings of different sizes with bright hot magenta round windows packed tightly around it, joined by short chrome tubes, a low dark gunmetal ring fence, and one thin tall silver antenna mast with a small ball on top; no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:MARTIAN:3/CALM: Subject: a large level-3 alien colony, the biggest of three sizes of one colony, crowded and grand: one huge landed flying saucer of polished silver-white chrome with a big pale glass dome and a ring of bright hot magenta lights in the middle, surrounded and filled from side to side by many round silver-white chrome dome buildings and two tall chrome towers with pale glass domes and bright hot magenta round windows, joined by chrome tubes, inside a low dark gunmetal ring wall with four small chrome pylons, and one thin very tall silver antenna mast with a small ball on top; no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:BEAM_DOWN: Subject: one small polished chrome flying saucer with a pale glass dome at the top of the image, shining one wide bright hot magenta light beam straight down from its underside, with one small silver-white trooper figure silhouette inside the beam near the bottom and two small pale pink sparkles; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:MIND_CONTROL: Subject: one big wrinkled pale lavender-grey brain with three bold curved hot magenta wave arcs radiating from each side of it and one small hot magenta spiral above it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:TRACTOR_BEAM: Subject: one polished chrome flying saucer at the top left of the image shining a slanted cone of bright hot magenta light down to the right, and one small round grey boulder lifted in the air inside the cone with two short pale pink motion lines pointing back toward the saucer; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:MARTIAN:RALLY: Subject: one polished chrome antenna dish on a short dark gunmetal stand, pointing up to the right, with three bold curved hot magenta signal arcs spreading out of it and one small pale pink four-pointed star; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:FORCE_FIELD: Subject: one short polished chrome emitter pylon with a dark gunmetal base and a small glowing hot magenta ball on top, standing under one big half-dome of thin bright hot magenta energy made of hexagon cells with a pale pink shine; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:STATUS:SHIELD: Subject: one big bold shield shape, a heater shield seen from the front, made of bright hot magenta energy with a pale pink inner shine and a thick dark outline, with one small white highlight in the upper left; flat and simple; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:STATUS:COOLING: Subject: one short chunky polished chrome ray gun barrel with ring coils, pointing to the right, its muzzle dark gunmetal and no longer glowing, with three wavy pale grey heat lines rising straight up from it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.EFFECT:HEAT_RAY: Subject: a round starburst flash of a heat ray hitting: short spiky flame tongues pointing outward in every direction from a round white-hot centre, white in the middle, then pale pink, then bright hot magenta, shaded with dark magenta, with a few small pale pink spark specks around it, floating in empty space; no base, no fire pit, no logs.
subjects.EFFECT:SHIELD_FLARE: Subject: a curved energy shield flaring as it stops a hit: one bold thick arc like a wide crescent bowed to the left, made of hexagon cells, bright hot magenta with a pale pink inner edge and one white flash star at its middle, shaded with dark magenta; floating in empty space; symmetrical top to bottom.
subjects.EFFECT:BEAM_DOWN: Subject: one tall narrow vertical column of light, a teleport beam: a straight pillar slightly wider at the bottom, bright hot magenta at its edges and pale pink to white in its middle, with four small white four-pointed sparkles rising inside it and one flat pale pink ring at its foot; floating in empty space; no saucer, no figure.
subjects.EFFECT:TRACTOR_BEAM: Subject: one cone of light, a tractor beam seen from the side: narrow at the top and widening towards the bottom, bright hot magenta at its edges and pale pink in its middle, crossed by three bold curved white rings one above the other like hoops; floating in empty space; no saucer, no figure.
subjects.EFFECT:MIND_CONTROL: Subject: a hypnosis swirl symbol: one bold spiral line winding three turns outward from its centre, bright hot magenta with a pale pink inner edge, shaded with dark magenta, with two small white four-pointed stars beside it; floating in empty space; round overall.
